description: This Java source file defines a custom assertion class `InfoProviderAssert` for testing instances of `ConnectionMonitor.InfoProvider`. It provides methods to verify various properties of `InfoProvider` objects, such as thing ID, timestamp, correlation ID, headers, and payload, to facilitate unit testing with AssertJ.

classes.name: InfoProviderAssert
classes.description: A custom assertion class extending AssertJ's AbstractAssert to provide fluent assertions for `ConnectionMonitor.InfoProvider` objects.

methods.name: assertThat
methods.description: Static factory method to create an `InfoProviderAssert` instance for a given `InfoProvider`.

methods.name: hasThingId
methods.description: Asserts that the `thingId` property of the `InfoProvider` matches the given value.

methods.name: hasNoThingId
methods.description: Asserts that the `thingId` property of the `InfoProvider` is null.

methods.name: hasTimestampBetween
methods.description: Asserts that the timestamp of the `InfoProvider` is between the specified start and end Instants.

methods.name: hasCorrelationId
methods.description: Asserts that the `correlationId` of the `InfoProvider` matches the given value.

methods.name: hasDefaultCorrelationId
methods.description: Asserts that the `correlationId` is the default value `<not-provided>`.

methods.name: hasHeaders
methods.description: Asserts that the headers map of the `InfoProvider` matches the given map.

methods.name: hasPayload
methods.description: Asserts that the payload of the `InfoProvider` matches the given string.

methods.name: hasTimestamp
methods.description: Asserts that the timestamp of the `InfoProvider` matches the given Instant.
